raw:
# Reference agent workflow: assigned feature/bug-fix issue -> reviewed,
# reviewer-assigned pull request.
#
# Status: specification preview. This file is validated against
# spec/agent-workflow.v1.schema.json in CI. No runtime executes it yet; it
# freezes the authored surface the workflow compiler will consume.
#
# Adopt by copying this file into your org catalog under the same id and
# editing the data: the reviewer team, the backend enum, the trigger.
kind: agent-workflow/v1
name: feature-request
on:
  issues:
    types: [assigned]
    assignee: outfitter-bot
permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
workspace: checkout

requires:
  governance: sdlc-baseline
  forge:
    issue-templates: [feature, bug-fix]

output:
  type: object
  additionalProperties: false
  required: [status, summary]
  properties:
    status:
      enum: [ready-for-human-review, blocked-prerequisites, revision-requested]
    summary:
      type: string
      minLength: 1
    pull-request:
      type: string
      format: uri

steps:
  - id: open-draft-pr
    agent: sdlc-engineer
    output:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [url, branch]
      properties:
        url: {type: string, format: uri}
        branch: {type: string, minLength: 1}

  # The plan is a work-graph/v1 document: the issue node, the explorers'
  # evidence nodes, and change nodes whose edit/create/test anchors are the
  # implementer's worklist. The runtime posts it; the planner writes nothing.
  - id: plan
    agent: sdlc-planner
    with:
      issue: ${{ trigger.issue.url }}
      pull-request: ${{ steps.open-draft-pr.output.url }}
    posts-to: ${{ steps.open-draft-pr.output.url }}
    output: ../spec/work-graph.v1.schema.json

  # Decision step: a script (or an LLM one-shot behind the same schema)
  # prints JSON whose enum the next step's runs-on reads. Routing decisions
  # are recorded like any other step output, so they can be evaluated later.
  - id: select-implementer
    run: ./bin/rank-implementers
    output:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [backend, reason]
      properties:
        backend: {enum: [local, copilot, kube-agent, actions]}
        reason: {type: string}

  - id: implement
    agent: sdlc-engineer
    with:
      plan: ${{ steps.plan.output }}
    runs-on: ${{ steps.select-implementer.output.backend }}

  # The reviewer receives the plan graph and appends finding nodes with
  # verifies/refutes edges to its change nodes; the runtime posts them.
  - id: review
    agent: sdlc-reviewer
    with:
      plan: ${{ steps.plan.output }}
      pull-request: ${{ steps.open-draft-pr.output.url }}
    posts-to: ${{ steps.open-draft-pr.output.url }}
    output: ./schemas/review-output.schema.json

  - if: steps.review.output.decision == 'changes-requested'
    emit:
      status: revision-requested
      summary: "Review requested changes; findings are on the pull request."
      pull-request: ${{ steps.open-draft-pr.output.url }}

  - id: undraft-and-assign
    agent: sdlc-engineer
    reviewers: [team:reviewers]
    emit:
      status: ready-for-human-review
      summary: "Change implemented, reviewed, and assigned for human review."
      pull-request: ${{ steps.open-draft-pr.output.url }}

emit.summary: Review requested changes; findings are on the pull request.
Change implemented, reviewed, and assigned for human review.

raw:
# Reference agent workflow: vulnerability report -> assessed, patched,
# reviewed pull request, or a recorded not-affected outcome.
#
# Status: specification preview. Validated against
# spec/agent-workflow.v1.schema.json in CI; no runtime executes it yet.
kind: agent-workflow/v1
name: vulnerability-fix
on:
  issues:
    types: [labeled]
    label: vulnerability
permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
workspace: checkout

requires:
  governance: sdlc-baseline
  forge:
    issue-templates: [vulnerability]

output:
  type: object
  additionalProperties: false
  required: [status, summary]
  properties:
    status:
      enum: [ready-for-human-review, not-affected, revision-requested]
    summary:
      type: string
      minLength: 1
    pull-request:
      type: string
      format: uri

steps:
  # The assessment carries its evidence and, when affected, the remediation
  # plan as a work graph beside the routing decision. Routing steps share one
  # convention: the enum `if:` routes on is named `decision`.
  - id: assess
    agent: sdlc-planner
    with:
      issue: ${{ trigger.issue.url }}
    output: ./schemas/assessment-output.schema.json

  - if: steps.assess.output.decision == 'not-affected'
    emit:
      status: not-affected
      summary: ${{ steps.assess.output.summary }}

  - id: open-draft-pr
    agent: sdlc-engineer
    output:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [url, branch]
      properties:
        url: {type: string, format: uri}
        branch: {type: string, minLength: 1}

  - id: patch
    agent: sdlc-engineer
    with:
      plan: ${{ steps.assess.output.graph }}

  - id: review
    agent: sdlc-reviewer
    with:
      plan: ${{ steps.assess.output.graph }}
      pull-request: ${{ steps.open-draft-pr.output.url }}
    posts-to: ${{ steps.open-draft-pr.output.url }}
    output: ./schemas/review-output.schema.json

  - if: steps.review.output.decision == 'changes-requested'
    emit:
      status: revision-requested
      summary: "Review requested changes; findings are on the pull request."
      pull-request: ${{ steps.open-draft-pr.output.url }}

  - id: undraft-and-assign
    agent: sdlc-engineer
    reviewers: [team:reviewers]
    emit:
      status: ready-for-human-review
      summary: "Vulnerability patched, reviewed, and assigned for human review."
      pull-request: ${{ steps.open-draft-pr.output.url }}

emit.summary: Review requested changes; findings are on the pull request.
Vulnerability patched, reviewed, and assigned for human review.
